summary.headline: Planetary Joys and Strengths
summary.text: Discussion of planetary joys, sorrows, strengths, and weaknesses across the twelve houses, assigning houses to Saturn, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, the Sun, Mercury, and the Moon. It explains cadency, opposition, Mercury’s mixed nature, and planetary condition in domicile, exaltation, angles, and aspects.
